concept: S3 Lifecycle: transition and expiration by object age
tests: Simplest way to automatically move objects to a cheaper class after 30 days and delete them after 365.
expected: S3 Lifecycle policy with a transition rule (30 days → cheaper class) and an expiration rule (365 days), no code. Triggers: "transition after 30 days", "deleted after 365 days", "automatically", "simplest".
why_not: A scheduled Lambda is unnecessary custom code; S3 Replication copies rather than changing class; manual moves mean errors and overhead.
